content:
Zoe (SRE): Published postmortem for the Dedicated tenant leak (VPC peering flap + on-prem route-policy mismatch). Short: peering failover timing + a misapplied route-map from customer edge created a transient cross-tenant path. Doc link in docs.

diag-bot: Postmortem created: /incidents/1890123456-dedicated-tenant-leak-postmortem.md :rotating_light:

Hector (Platform): Can we capture owners + deadlines here so I can make infra tasks?

Zoe (SRE): Action items (brief):
• Peering health daemon (control-plane + data-plane TCP probe) — owner: Hector (Platform) — due: 2026-06-07
• On-prem policy detector e2e tests + fixtures — owner: Lina (Support) — due: 2026-06-14
• Dedicated onboarding isolation check (passive default, active opt-in) — owner: Lina (Support) — due: 2026-06-01
• Customer comms + NOC one-pager + legal review — owner: Omar (Customer Success) — due: 2026-05-30

Hector (Platform): Plan: daemonset on dedicated nodes, run from node netns, checks: `describe-vpc-peering-connections` + small TCP handshake to peer IPs. Opening INF-7201. PR incoming.

Lina (Support): I'll build the verification script. Default passive checks: `ip route`, `ip neigh`, `iptables -L -n`. Optional active `tcpdump -c50` when customer consents. ETA 3 days.

Zoe (SRE): Sample customer snippet we saw (redacted):
```
route-map RM-DEFAULT permit 10
 match ip address 110
 set ip next-hop 192.0.2.254
!
# observed default route present on edge
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 192.0.2.254
```

Omar (Customer Success): Drafting comms + one-pager. Sending to legal today (~48h). Will include a short safe-check list for NOC.

Zoe (SRE): Recurring pattern note: this is the fourth peering-related isolation-class incident in ~12 months. Proposal: monthly "isolation-pattern" retro to surface config anti-patterns and prioritize linter rules. Owner: Zoe. Start: 2026-06-03.

Hector (Platform): Also adding onboarding linter rule to flag default-originate without explicit next-hop validation (INF-7202).

Lina (Support): Q: many customers won't share BGP logs. Confirming passive-only is fine for default checks?

Zoe (SRE): Yes — passive default. Active debugging requires opt-in consent and legal OK for upload of any captures. Document both modes in runbook.

Hector (Platform): Will link INF-7201/7202 PRs in the postmortem follow-ups and set reminders. Zoe, can you run a 2-week check on 2026-06-21 to close items?

Zoe (SRE): Will do. Please add ticket & PR links to the postmortem doc as they land. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
